name: nodeviz
description: A visual canvas for dbt projects: see how your models connect, and sketch new ones as boxes that become .sql files.

dbtFlow.openOnStartup.description: Open the canvas next to your code when a dbt project is opened.

dbtFlow.projectPath.description: Folder that holds dbt_project.yml, absolute or relative to the workspace. Leave empty to find it automatically.

dbtFlow.confirmFileEdits.description: Ask before adding a ref() to an existing .sql file when you connect two boxes.

dbtFlow.openCreatedFile.description: Open the new .sql file after Create file.

dbtFlow.dbt.executable.description: The dbt command typed into the NodeViz terminal, or its full path, e.g. ~/.venvs/dbt-databricks/bin/dbt.

dbtFlow.dbt.target.description: Added as --target to every dbt command. Leave empty for the profile's default target.

dbtFlow.dbt.envFile.description: A file of KEY=VALUE or export lines (e.g. ~/.databricks.env) loaded once into the NodeViz terminal, like running source on it yourself.

dbtFlow.integrations.dagtracer.enabled.description: Use DAGtracer (dgt) to trace where a column stops in the DAG, when dgt is installed.

dbtFlow.integrations.dagtracer.executabl.description: The dgt command, or its full path, e.g. /home/you/projects/dagtracer/.venv/bin/dgt.

dbtFlow.integrations.dagtracer.timeoutSe.description: Stop a dgt run that takes longer than this.

scripts.test: node --test test/model.test.js test/extension.test.js test/removeref.test.js test/dbtrun.test.js test/aliases.test.js test/host.test.js test/dagtracer.test.js test/dagtracer-ui.test.js test/architecture.test.js
